question: My disk is full. What is ~/.cache/gage-dev-target?
steps: The agent searches your logs for the commands that named the directory.
It checks whether the work that used it was merged.
answer: It is build output from the Codex driver work. One session created it and sent every build there.
It is large because that session built a stack of six branches in it and rebuilt each one after rebases. Nothing ever cleaned it up.
That work is finished and merged, so nothing depends on the directory. Deleting it frees 525 GB.
